title: Chapter 287: Breaking Through Rule-Level Defense
content:
Chapter 287: Breaking Through Rule-Level Defense

The Zerg puppies that were closer to the center of the Zerg Explosive Mosquito explosion had all burrowed underground in advance to avoid the impact of the explosion.

The powerful air wave generated by the explosion rushed into the 996th City of the Tianwai Human Race, affecting the fighting Tianwai Human Race army and Zerg puppies.

The Zerg main combat units, which were in a defensive state to withstand the falling attack of large-scale battlefield magic stars, also felt the terrible impact of this explosion.

"The power of this explosion is more terrifying than the attack of a strong person!"

"I didn't expect that the self-destruction power of the Zerg's self-destruction troops can be superimposed in large quantities. It's really scary!"

"The Tianwai human race has been cheating by using all kinds of rare battlefield items. Fortunately, the Zerg race is really not weak, otherwise they would have been defeated long ago!"

"I wonder if the battlefield wonders of the Tianwai Human Race can withstand such an attack!"

"..."

Observers from all forces in the local camp expressed their dissatisfaction with the Outer Human Race's continuous use of various powerful battlefield auxiliary items and frequent use of rule-level forces to participate in the battle.

But these are in line with the rules of the battlefield. They can only lament that the Tianwai human race has a profound heritage and have no other way.

At this time, Wu Qing did not immediately pay attention to the mysterious chariot of the human race in the sky that was bombed, but was checking whether the upgrade conditions of the Zerg nest were met.

When he saw that the number of six-star creatures killed became 10/10, he instantly felt that the outcome of this battlefield was no longer so important!

Wu Qing wanted to return to the Zerg territory base camp immediately to upgrade the Zerg nest, but he immediately suppressed this idea.

Being able to win this war with the outer human race will of course be better for the future development of the Zerg race.

Through the five-star Zerg host, Wu Qing had already seen clearly the situation of the mysterious human chariot at the center of the explosion and the army it was guarding.

The situation there was very strange. The five-star cavalry troops of the Outer Worlds and the surviving powerful mages seemed to have been greatly impacted by the terrorist explosion, but the protective energy cover of the mysterious chariot was not broken.

"I don't believe it can't be broken!"

Wu Qing thought, and all the remaining five-star Zerg explosive mosquitoes swooped down towards the center of the explosion where the aftermath of the explosion had not yet ended!

There were more five-star Zerg explosive mosquitoes attacking at the same time this time. These five-star Zerg explosive mosquitoes consumed a lot of resources. Wu Qing did not hesitate to consume a lot of resources just to test whether the rule-level defense could be broken. .

"boom……!"

After only a short interval of time, another even more shocking loud noise sounded!

Before most people could recover, the second more violent self-destruction attack of the five-star Zerg Explosive Mosquitoes arrived.

This big explosion directly caused a strong impact on the large-scale battlefield magic stars falling not far away, and it ended early!

People from all sides who were far away from the center of the explosion felt the terrible impact.

Wu Qing also felt that the power of this explosion even exceeded the power of the attack launched by the Insect Queen in Guangfu City.

Wu Qing has been staring at the mysterious chariot of the outer human race through the five-star Zerg host. Through the impact of the explosion, Wu Qing has sensed the status of the mysterious chariot.

"After all, there is a limit!"

The rule-level defensive energy of the mysterious chariot of the Tianwai Human Race has finally disappeared!

The nearly 20,055-star Tianwai Human Race's own heavy cavalry and the more than 2,000 Tianwai Human Race powerful mage guarded by it lost the protection of the rule-level defense. In this terrifying explosion, which was comparable to the attack power of a seven-star strong man. Below, there were heavy deaths.

A large number of five-star Zerg Explosive Mosquitoes self-destructed at the same time, and the combined power has reached the seven-star level. Five-star troops, under such an attack, even with a large number of magical blessings, it is difficult to survive!

Most of the five-star extraterrestrial heavy cavalry and hard-to-distinguish powerful mages from the outer world turned into light and disappeared under such a terrifying attack!

Those who survived were basically the five-star heavy cavalry of the Outer Worlds who had extremely strong defensive capabilities and were far away from the center of the explosion.

"Too strong!"

"This kind of attack! Even strong men from all races have to retreat when faced with it!"

"The Zerg used five-star troops to display such combat power! It's unimaginable!"

"..."

Everyone was shocked by the second attack of the five-star Zerg Explosive Mosquito. This was a perfect demonstration of the transformation from quantitative to qualitative changes in combat power!

The Tianwai human race did not expect that the superimposed attacks of the Zerg Explosive Mosquitoes would be so powerful that even powerful battlefield wonders could not withstand them.

The originally good battlefield situation was about to change under this explosion.

But everyone firmly believes that the Zerg can exert seven-star strength with five-star troops, and it must have paid a huge price, but no one can see this price.

The Tianwai Human Race also thinks the same way. They don't believe that the Zerg can continue to launch such attacks in a short time, just like they can't get another battlefield wonder in a short time.

After the war has reached this level, the Tianwai Human Race will definitely not be willing to retreat like this. They will never admit that the Tianwai Human Race cannot defeat the Zerg.

Therefore, this counterattack launched by the outer human army must continue!

Nothing happened to the mysterious chariot of the outer human race and the group of white horses pulling it.

At this time, the defense of the mysterious chariot was broken. The group of white horses changed their previous leisurely demeanor, turned around, and ran towards the 996th City of the Tianwai Human Race at a very fast speed.

The Zerg Queen wanted to attack the group of white horses, but could not lock on the target. Those white horses did not seem to be real creatures.

Several Zerg Queens used trapping nets on the group of white horses and the mysterious chariot, but it was useless.

Wu Qing could only look at the mysterious chariot of the alien race and ran back again.

More than 5,000 seriously injured five-star alien race heavy cavalry and a few alien race mages were left behind.

Two thousand five-star Zerg Queens began to use parasitic control to control the remaining remnants. These remnants were basically powerful heavy cavalry with five-star strength, and it was very useful to keep them.

All kinds of divine arts were gone, and the five-star heavy cavalry of the alien race that was severely injured was much less difficult to parasitically control. It would not take much longer for them to become the parasitic human heavy cavalry of the Zerg.

"Boom boom boom...!"

The Zerg destroyer resumed the attack.

All the Zerg destroyers whose strength has been upgraded to two stars or above were injured by the falling magic stars in the large battlefield of the alien race, but there was almost no loss of personnel.

Zerg destroyers evolved from Zerg cockroaches, and their self-healing recovery ability ranks first among all Zerg arms.

In addition, the Zerg destroyers are large in size and can withstand more damage.

However, the attack effect of the falling magic stars in the large battlefield is really good. Not only is the attack coverage large, but the attack duration is also quite strong.

At least half of the two-star Zerg destroyers have been affected by the damage they have suffered.

Therefore, the high-star Zerg destroyers and nearly half of the two-star Zerg destroyers can be put into battle immediately.

This makes the super-long-range firepower support of the Zerg destroyers much weaker, and the situation of the Zerg puppies in the front blocking operation has not improved much, and they still cannot stop the large-scale assault of the alien army.

Among the main Zerg combat units, the most serious losses were suffered by the one-star Zerg Hydralisks and the one-star Type II Zerg Poison Ray Scorpions that had just come to reinforce.

Their defense was relatively weaker among the main Zerg combat units, and they had the largest total force, and the one-star force accounted for the vast majority. Under the continuous attack of the powerful purification and annihilation energy, many of them were killed and disappeared.

The rest were basically scarred, and most of them lost their combat capability.

The situation of the Zerg cockroaches was much better. They had the strongest self-healing ability, and it was not easy to kill them.

There was a small number of casualties among the one-star Zerg cockroaches, and many were injured, but the recovery speed was very fast, which had little impact on combat effectiveness.

As for the Zerg stealth spiders that had been lurking underground and preparing for battle, they completely escaped this disaster and did not suffer any damage.

Finally, according to the statistics of the Queen of the Zerg, after enduring the baptism of the falling magic stars in the large battlefield of the alien race, although the main combat units of the Zerg suffered the largest loss in history, more than half of the troops were still able to fight.

At this time, the layer of light attribute energy covering the ground disappeared, which was the duration of the battlefield magic.

A large number of Zerg main combat arms that lost their combat effectiveness all went underground to rest and recover.

In this round of competition, the Zerg suffered a lot of losses, but the gains were incomparably huge!

Apart from other gains, the gains from the system resources alone were enough for the Zerg to build another Zerg main combat arm force.

In particular, after breaking the defense of the mysterious chariot of the alien race and forcing it away, the system instantly gained a large amount of Qi resources.

Wu Qing knew that this triggered a certain world rule, and the Zerg took a deep breath from the alien race and transported it over.

With enough resources, Wu Qing immediately made up for the main combat arms lost by the Zerg at the first Zerg sub-base.

Wu Qing, who had already made a lot of money, no longer had much expectations for the next battle.

But he still had to watch this blocking battle to the end.

With the firepower support of the Zerg Destroyers, the Zerg Puppies still couldn't stop the advance of the alien army.

More alien ultra-long-range siege equipment participated in the battle, and shells from siege equipment kept flying towards the positions of the Zerg main combat arms, testing the anti-aircraft firepower of the Zerg main combat arms.

More siege equipment shells flew to the position of the Zerg Puppies, forcing the Zerg Puppies to choose to fight with the alien army and no longer form a defense line.

The alien army already had a way to deal with the Zerg Puppies that suddenly drilled out of the ground. They used their relative strength and combat power advantages to suppress the Zerg Puppies that kept drilling out of the ground and could not form a large-scale attack.
